title: Digital Presence
description: Developing the knowledge and skills needed to reach a wider audience and enhance your online credibility is a must for you to thrive in the digital business environment. In this course, join Nadzirah Hashim, who helps you create and manage a powerful online presence that showcases your professional brand. Let's embark on an exciting journey to effectively market your business and engage with your audience!

title: Securing Your First Job
description: Finding a job that matches with your career and life aspirations is a goal for many. To find a job that fits you best, you need to know yourself first. In this course, you will explore your aspirations and then, learn ways to find and secure employment. Finding and securing a job is a skill in itself.

title: Managing Your First Client
description: Managing clients can be challenging at times, and knowing how to manage the client will benefit the client and you. We will explore different strategies and perspectives on good business practices, how to nurture client relationships, manage conflicts and clients, legal tips to protect you, and steps to close a job that will lead you to better client management.

title: Skills Test - Operation Management
description: Improve your operational management skills with Skills Test - Operational Management. Led by industry experts, this course provides personalised evaluation and feedback on your ability to manage resources, optimise processes, and implement strategies to enhance efficiency and productivity. Benchmark your skills against market standards and take your operations management career to the next level. Enrol now and advance your career.

title: Skills Profiling
description: Having the right skill sets could take your career to the next level. However, profiling skills can be tedious and confusing. For this course, you will learn how to choose career pathways based on your skills, identify your unique skill sets as well as areas that would need some sharpening.

title: Skills Test: Digital Marketing
description: Take your digital marketing skills to the next level with Skills Test: Digital Marketing. This course provides a personalised evaluation of your skills in areas such as SEO, SEM, email marketing, and more. Led by industry experts, you'll receive feedback and recommendations to improve your performance and succeed in the fast-paced world of digital marketing. Enrol today to enhance your skills and advance your career.

title: Pitch Perfect: Crafting and Presenting Your Winning Proposition
description: This course focused the art of effective pitching, covering the purpose and opportunities it offers. Participants learn to build persuasive pitch decks using Visual Storytelling, focusing on showcasing solutions impactfully. The training covers components of a good pitch, emphasizing body language, voice, and recovery skills. Understanding the importance of tailored pitches, participants also learn to recover from unexpected situations. The course highlights the step-by-step process of creating impactful pitch decks for stakeholder engagement, raising awareness, and securing funding.

title: Driving Change: ESG Strategies for Lasting Business Impact
description: This course covered the fundamentals of ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) principles in business. You will learn the meaning and importance of ESG, the difference between measurement and reporting, and the stages in developing an ESG framework. The course emphasizes the benefits of ESG implementation, including the integration of Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). You will also discover the significance of clear and concise messaging for effective communication of ESG strategies to stakeholders, fostering transparency and trust.

title: Securing Your First Client
description:
Finding your first client can be the most challenging part of your freelancing journey. We will explore the different methods and channels for sourcing clients, employ your resources to secure clients, utilize an entrepreneurial mindset, and learn strategies to calculate the rate for your freelancing service. 

A large part of being an entrepreneur is being resourceful and staying resilient in the face of adversity. We’ll show you how to tap into available networks you have at your disposal today and we’ll help you build your first client relationship.

title: Personal Finance
description: Becoming financially independent is a goal that everyone wants to achieve, but the path to gaining this independence can often be complicated. Through understanding your personal financial habits, you will be able to create a plan to  manage your finances and budget accordingly in order to lead a more financially sustainable lifestyle.

title: Thriving In Your Job
description: After the overwhelming process of finishing school, searching for and landing your first job, you are now about to launch your career. The transition from school to work can be exhausting and stressful. Learning how to succeed in your new role is important. We will explore the essence of thriving in your career, portraying a growth mindset and strategies to develop your career.

Pendidik dapat aktif mengkodekan dan mendesain ulang pembelajaran sesuai rubrik 21CLD.

Through real-world success stories, you’ll gain insights into proven marketing techniques and learn how to apply them to your own business. By the end of the course, you’ll have the knowledge and tools to develop a brand that stands out in today’s competitive market.

In this course, you will learn to enhance their communication strategies, including messaging, storytelling, digital marketing, and media engagement. title: Boost Your Productivity with Microsoft Copilot
description:
This module provides an in-depth look at how Microsoft Copilot can enhance your productivity. You'll learn how to use Copilot to bring your ideas to life, manage your time more effectively, and support your job search and skill development. The module also covers how Copilot can assist with analyzing images and documents, along with providing workplace support.

By the end of this module, you'll be able to:
1. Evaluate the effectiveness of Copilot in supporting skill development and career advancement.
2. Use Copilot to optimize personal and professional schedules, draft messages and emails, plan projects, and manage time.
3. Evaluate the effectiveness of the retrieval-augmented generation method of Copilot in providing relevant and up-to-date information for your questions.

Terokai seni menghasilkan idea, menyusun pemikiran, memodelkan pangkalan data, menjalankan penyelidikan pasaran, dan menghasilkan cadangan perniagaan yang menarik menggunakan kemampuan unik Chat GPT. Welcome to your onboarding journey! This course is your go-to guide for understanding how we work, what tools you’ll use, and how you can lead impactful, efficient projects from day one.

description: Meneroka transformasi digital dapat membawa perniagaan anda ke tahap yang lebih tinggi. Dalam kursus ini, anda akan mempelajari strategi-strategi transformasi digital seperti model perniagaan, pasukan, sistem pembayaran, dan data. Ketahui bagaimana semua elemen ini dapat meningkatkan pertumbuhan, kecekapan, dan pengalaman kerja pasukan anda. Sertai kami untuk memacu perniagaan anda ke arah transformasi digital!

title: AI Fluency for Corporates
description: This learning path is designed by Microsoft Learn, to provide a comprehensive understanding of AI. It includes modules that cover various aspects of AI, starting with foundational concepts and progressing to more advanced topics. Each module is tailored to help individuals and organizations apply AI technologies to enhance their digital skilling efforts. This impact program is brought to you Microsoft Philanthropies.

title: Reka Bentuk & Pembangunan Web
description: Tingkatkan kemahiran reka bentuk dan pembangunan  web anda dengan mengambil Ujian Kemahiran - Reka Bentuk & Pembangunan Web. Kursus ini menawarkan penilaian dan maklum balas secara individu daripada pakar industri untuk menambah baik keupayaan anda dalam penyediaan laman web bervisual menarik, mengoptimumkan pengalaman pengguna dan membangunkan aplikasi laman web yang mantap. Bandingkan kemahiran anda dengan standard pasaran dan bawa kerjaya anda dalam bidang reka bentuk dan pembangunan web ke tahap yang seterusnya. Daftar hari ini dan tingkatkan kemahiran anda.

title: Pengurusan Klien Anda
description: Menguruskan klien adakalanya mencabar dan mengetahui cara mengurus mereka boleh memudahkan kedua-dua pihak - diri anda dan klien sendiri. Mari teroka beberapa strategi dan perspektif berkaitan praktis bisnes yang baik, cara menjaga hubungan dengan klien, pengurusan konflik, tip perundangan untuk melindungi hak anda serta pendekatan yang bukan sahaja menguntungkan, tetapi membuatkan reputasi anda dengan klient menjadi lebih baik.

title: Strategi Berkomunikasi untuk Penglibatan Awam dan Pengaruh
description: Komunikasi berkesan diakui sebagai kunci utama dalam meningkatkan penglibatan dengan orang awam, pemberi dana, dan pembuat dasar. Dalam kursus ini, anda akan mempelajari cara memperkukuh strategi komunikasi anda, termasuk penyampaian mesej, penceritaan, pemasaran digital, dan penglibatan media. Dengan mengasah kemahiran komunikasi, anda akan lebih bersedia untuk meningkatkan kesedaran, menarik pembiayaan, dan mempengaruhi keputusan dasar.

title: Explore Responsible AI
description:
Understand and implement responsible AI practices, including best practices, principles, and the global implications of human-AI interaction.

By completing this module, you'll be able to:
1. Evaluate the ethical implications in AI by critically analyzing AI-generated content and cross-verifying information from multiple sources.
2. Assess the ethical and security concerns associated with deepfakes, including their potential misuse in spreading misinformation and impersonation.
3. Evaluate the global human-AI interactions by analyzing key factors such as data privacy, algorithmic bias, transparency, and legal liability.

title: Technological Adoption for Business Transformation
description: Technological Adoption for Business Transformation explores the role of technology in driving business efficiency and growth, with a focus on empowering women entrepreneurs. Led by Amalia Hayati, Chief Content Officer for Bawana, this course provides insights into digital transformation strategies, technology-driven business models, and success stories of women leveraging tech for innovation. Learn how to integrate digital tools, enhance operational efficiency, and stay competitive in an evolving marketplace.

title: Reflections on Future-Forward Insights
description: Reflections on Future-Forward Insights explores goal-setting psychology, structured frameworks, and strategic planning tools for long-term success. Led by Mala K, Training & Mentorship Manager at Mereka, this course provides insights into BHAG (Big, Hairy, Audacious Goals), SMART goals, WOOP, PACT, OKRs, and SWOT/PESTLE analysis. Learn how to align your goals with your vision, stay motivated, and use strategic planning to make informed decisions.

title: Preparation Course for Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900)
description: Pelatihan Azure AI Fundamentals dirancang untuk siapa saja yang tertarik untuk mempelajari tentang jenis solusi yang dimungkinkan oleh kecerdasan buatan (AI), dan layanan di Microsoft Azure yang dapat kamu gunakan untuk membuatnya. Kamu tidak perlu memiliki pengalaman menggunakan Microsoft Azure sebelum mengikuti pelatihan ini, cukup memiliki tingkat dasar komputer dan internet.

title: Embracing the Evolution of Leadership
description: Embracing the Evolution of Leadership is designed to help entrepreneurs and professionals navigate the changing leadership landscape. Led by Mallory Loone, this course explores the transformation of leadership, resilience in business, and inclusive leadership practices. Through real-world insights and case studies, you’ll learn how to adapt to modern leadership challenges, foster innovation, and lead with confidence. By the end of this course, you’ll be equipped with the strategies needed to thrive in today’s evolving business environment.

title: Pengenalan Kepada Learning Accelerators
description: Learning Accelerators ialah kategori baharu alat pembelajaran dalam Microsoft 365 Education yang memudahkan proses penyediaan, semakan, dan analisis tugasan latihan, sambil menyediakan bimbingan masa nyata kepada pelajar bagi membantu mereka mengajar, mengekalkan, dan meningkatkan prestasi pembelajaran. Learning Accelerators direka untuk membantu pendidik membuka potensi sepenuhnya setiap pelajar melalui alat yang menyokong kemahiran asas dan kemahiran masa hadapan. Dengan alat ini, pendidik dapat memberi peluang tambahan kepada setiap pelajar untuk belajar, berlatih, dan menerima bimbingan yang disasarkan secara serta-merta dalam persekitaran inklusif yang menyokong penambahbaikan berterusan.

title: Digital Transformation
description: Discovering digital transformation will bring your business to the next level. In the Digital Transformation course, you’ll learn about digital transformation strategies, including business models, teams, payments, and data. Discover how these can enhance growth, efficiency, and team experience. Join us and propel your business towards digital transformation!

title: Boosting Sales and Productivity with ChatGPT Insights
description: Unlock the full potential of Chat GPT and skyrocket your sales and productivity in this dynamic course! Discover powerful techniques to leverage Chat GPT and seize sales opportunities like never before. Dive deep into the art of idea generation, thought organisation, database modelling, market research, and crafting compelling business proposals using the unmatched capabilities of Chat GPT. Gain the edge you need to excel in the fast-paced world of business. Join us and revolutionise the way you create sales opportunities, boost productivity, and take your success to new heights!

title: ChatGPT for Job Search and Career Development
description: Learn how to use Chat GPT to your advantage in your job search and beyond with the help of this course. You will learn how to network successfully, produce compelling cover letters, resumes, and LinkedIn profiles, and negotiate a higher salary using Chat GPT.

title: Pikat Hati Klien Pertama Anda
description: Satu ciri utama usahawan adalah bijak mencari solusi dan cekal menempuh cabaran. Dalam kursus ini, anda akan pelajari cara mendekati jaringan sedia ada serta membina hubungan dengan klien pertama anda.

title: Dapatkan Pekerjaan Idaman Anda
description: Mendapatkan pekerjaan yang menepati aspirasi kerjaya dan hidup adalah impian ramai orang. Bagi mendapatkan kerja yang sesuai, anda perlu mengenali diri sendiri terlebih dahulu. Dalam kursus ini, anda akan teroka aspirasi anda. Kemudian, anda akan pelajari langkah mencari dan mendapatkan pekerjaan yang juga merupakan satu kemahiran.

title: Wibawa dalam Kerjaya Anda
description: Selepas menamatkan fasa alam persekolahan, mencari pekerjaan dan mendapat pekerjaan pertama yang melelahkan, kini anda akan memulakan kerjaya. Perubahan dari alam persekolahan dan pekerjaan boleh jadi amat memenatkan dan memberi tekanan. Mempelajari cara untuk berjaya dalam peranan baharu ini adalah penting. Kita akan lihat rahsia untuk berwibawa dalam kerjaya, memegang prinsip minda dinamik dan strategi untuk membangunkan kerjaya anda.

title: Transformational Leadership and Social Impact
description: This course offers a comprehensive exploration of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) factors, their impact on business models, and the role of leadership in driving social change. It covers ESG measurement, reporting, and implementation, alongside personal mastery, emotional intelligence, resilience building, and ethical leadership. The course concludes with a focus on leadership theories for social change and strategies for overcoming resistance in social innovation, equipping learners with the skills to drive positive environmental change.

title: Pitch Perfect: Merangka dan Menyampaikan Cadangan yang Meyakinkan
description: Kursus ini memberi tumpuan kepada seni membentang yang berkesan, merangkumi tujuan dan peluang yang ditawarkannya. Peserta belajar untuk membina dek pembentangan yang persuasif menggunakan Penceritaan Visual, fokus kepada cara menunjukkan penyelesaian dengan berkesan. Latihan ini merangkumi komponen pembentangan yang baik, menekankan bahasa tubuh, suara, dan kemahiran beradaptasi. Dengan memahami kepentingan pembentangan yang dikhususkan, peserta juga belajar untuk beradaptasi pada situasi yang tidak dijangka. Kursus ini menekankan proses langkah demi langkah dalam mencipta dek pembentangan yang berimpak untuk mendapat perhatian pemegang kepentingan, meningkatkan kesedaran, dan mendapatkan pembiayaan.

title: AI for Good: Unlocking Potential for Social Impact
description: Explore how Artificial Intelligence (AI) can be a powerful tool for addressing real-world challenges and driving social good. This course blends essential AI knowledge with practical applications, focusing on its use in social, environmental, and ethical contexts. Designed for Indonesian youth, this course provides the skills and insights needed to create meaningful AI-driven projects that benefit communities.

title: AI for Educator (Bahagian 2)
description: Terokai potensi kecerdasan buatan (AI) dalam bidang pendidikan. Kandungan ini merangkumi sejarah ringkas AI, model bahasa besar (LLM), AI generatif, kejuruteraan prompt, penggunaan AI secara bertanggungjawab, serta penerapannya dalam suasana bilik darjah. Pelajari seni membina prompt bagi membantu peserta memperoleh hasil terbaik daripada Microsoft Copilot dan Image Creator daripada Designer. Temui pelbagai cara untuk mempertingkatkan proses pengajaran dan pembelajaran menggunakan alat berkuasa AI dalam sistem pelayar Microsoft Edge, Word, PowerPoint, Minecraft, dan lain-lain.

title: ESG Approach to Sustainability & Social Impact
description: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) factors and their impact on business models. It also explores leadership evolution and the design, management, and scaling of social impact business models.

title: Civic Engagement
description: "Civic Engagements" is your gateway to empowerment as a future young leader within the civic engagement ecosystem. This course provides you with a permanent resource to equip you with essential knowledge, skills, and tools for your active participation in future campaigns and civic movements. You will gain a deep understanding of civic processes, learn the importance of inclusivity, develop crucial leadership skills, and embrace your civic responsibilities. "Civic Engagements" empowers you to make a lasting impact on your community and society as a whole by actively engaging in the democratic process.

title: AI Explorers: Hour of Code with Minecraft Education
description: Program the Minecraft Agent to collect data about forest fires. Learn coding basics and explore a real-world example of artificial intelligence.

title: Terokai AI Secara Bertanggungjawab
description: Sesuai untuk mereka yang baru ingin memahami mengenai kecerdasan buatan (artificial intelligence).  Laluan pembelajaran ini direka bentuk untuk memberikan pemahaman menyeluruh tentang AI. Ia termasuk modul yang merangkumi pelbagai aspek AI, bermula dengan konsep asas dan maju ke topik yang lebih maju. Setiap modul disesuaikan untuk membantu individu dan organisasi menggunakan teknologi AI untuk meningkatkan usaha pemahaman mereka mengenai kecerdasan buatan.

title: Employee Onboarding
description:
Welcome abroad! We are excited to have you join us!
Whether you’re coming onboard as an intern or a full-time team member, this onboarding course is designed to help you get started smoothly!

You will be introduced to our company, including who we are, how we work, and how our teams are structured. You will also get a clear overview of our organizational chart so you can understand roles, reporting lines, and how different departments collaborate.

To help you settle in quickly, we will guide you step by step through getting started with our company software tools. This includes login instructions and introductions to the systems you will be using in your daily work. Each section includes simple explanations and tutorial videos to help you become familiar with our tools at your own pace.

We encourage you to go through each module carefully and refer back to them whenever needed. This course is here to support you as you begin your journey with us.

If you have any questions, need clarification, or face any issues along the way, please don’t hesitate to reach out to the HR team. We are always happy to help.

Once again, welcome aboard, and we wish you a great start with us!

title: ESG Fundamentals: Principles and Practices
description: In this course, you will develop a fundamental understanding of ESG, its significance in the corporate world, and how to apply it in a professional context. Topics covered include the basics of ESG, associated risks and opportunities, implementation strategies, and stakeholder management. The course is intended for corporate professionals who are interested in learning about ESG and is suitable for beginners who have no or little prior knowledge of ESG.

title: Leveraging Digital Solutions for Business Resilience
Learning Accelerators in Action (EN)
description: This module introduces three powerful Learning Accelerators integrated into Microsoft Teams—Reading Progress, Math Progress, and Speaker Progress—each designed to strengthen essential literacy, numeracy, and communication skills in a personalized, data-driven way.

title: AI for Educator (Part 1)
description: Explore the potential of artificial intelligence (AI) in education. This includes a brief history of AI, large language models (LLMs), generative AI, prompt engineering, responsible use of AI, and its use in classroom settings. Delve into the art of the prompt to equip learners to get the best results from Microsoft Copilot and Image Creator from Designer. Discover various ways to enhance teaching and learning with AI-powered tools in the Microsoft Edge browser, Word, PowerPoint, Minecraft, and more.

title: Unlocking Digital Success  for Women-led Businesses
AI Fluency (EN)
description: This learning path is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of AI. It includes modules that cover various aspects of AI, starting with foundational concepts and progressing to more advanced topics.

title: Personal Branding
description: This module will help you gain a clear understanding of personal branding and its importance in creating your unique value proposition to build a public identity with your community and potential clients.

title: Project Management Onboarding
description:
Welcome! We will introduce you to our project management approach, including key workflows, roles, and expectations. You will gain an overview of how teams collaborate across departments, track progress, and communicate effectively throughout a project’s lifecycle.

If you have any questions or need support at any point, please reach out to the HR team or your project lead for assistance. We are here to support you every step of the way.
Welcome aboard, and we look forward to working with you!

title: Developing Women-Driven Leadership Skills
description: Courageous Leadership is a transformative webinar featuring Izzana Salleh, CEO of RISE Human Capital, designed to equip women entrepreneurs and professionals with essential leadership skills. This session explores key leadership traits, strategies for fostering inclusive workplaces, and ways to leverage digital tools for success. Through real-world insights and expert guidance, participants will gain the confidence to lead with impact, drive change, and thrive in today’s evolving business landscape.

title: Strategic Corporate Advancement
description: Strategic Corporate Advancement is designed to help businesses navigate corporate procurement, supplier expectations, and global market opportunities. Led by Mrinalini (Minnie) Venkatachalam, Regional Director for Southeast Asia and Oceania at WEConnect International, this course explores the procurement cycle, supplier selection criteria, and the role of supplier diversity. Gain practical insights into preparing your business for corporate partnerships, meeting compliance standards, and leveraging supplier networks for growth. By the end of this course, you’ll be equipped with the strategies needed to compete successfully in global supply chains.

title: Financial Management for Business Growth
description: Business Marketing and Branding: Financial Planning for Business Growth and Long-Term Stability is designed to equip entrepreneurs with essential financial strategies to sustain and scale their businesses. Led by Muhammad Syafiq Shamsuddin, Head of Brand & Stakeholder Management at MAVCAP, this course explores key financial planning principles, including budgeting, cash flow management, capital allocation, and risk mitigation. Learn how to make informed financial decisions, align financial goals with business objectives, and integrate Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) practices for long-term sustainability. By the end of this course, you'll have the knowledge and tools to create a solid financial roadmap for business success.

title: Women in Entrepreneurship
description: The Women in Entrepreneurship (WiE) programme is a transformative initiative dedicated to empowering and advancing women-led startups in Malaysia. Designed to bridge gender disparities in the entrepreneurial landscape, this programme offers a comprehensive platform for female entrepreneurs to thrive in the competitive tech industry. The Women in Entrepreneurship programme strives to close the gender gap in entrepreneurship, creating a level playing field for all. It fosters inclusive communities, promotes gender equality, and generates employment opportunities, contributing to the sustainable development of Malaysia.

title: Explore AI Basics
description: Discover the world of artificial intelligence by exploring its foundational concepts and history. Learn how AI technology powers everyday items and transforms your daily life.

title: Get Started with Microsoft Copilot
description:
This module provides an introduction to Microsoft Copilot, covering its main functions, benefits, and strategies for effective interaction. Learn about GPT model fundamentals, setup, and tips for engaging conversations.

By completing this module, you’ll be able to:
1. Critically assess the main functions and benefits of Copilot at enhancing productivity and creativity.
2. Identify and apply specific strategies to interact with Copilot effectively, ensuring productive and meaningful conversations by providing detailed prompts and feedback.
3. Explain the fundamental aspects of GPT models, including their architecture and capabilities, and how these features enable the generation of human-like text.

title: Explore AI for All
description:
Discover how AI is transforming accessibility, job roles, and humanitarian efforts through real-world examples and case studies.

By completing this module, you'll be able to:
1. Assess how AI initiatives are enhancing accessibility for individuals with disabilities.
2. Evaluate the impact of AI on various job roles by analyzing specific examples from different sectors such as finance, healthcare, energy, manufacturing, retail, public sector, and agriculture.
3. Evaluate the effectiveness of AI-driven solutions in enhancing humanitarian action by analyzing case studies and real-world applications.

title: Skills Test: Content Writing
description: Assess and enhance your content writing skills with Skills Test - Content Writing. Led by industry experts, this course provides personalized evaluation and feedback to benchmark your skills against market standards. Improve your writing abilities and succeed in the competitive field of content writing. Enrol now to take the first step towards becoming a top-tier content writer.

title: Getting Started to Unlocking the Power of ChatGPT: Beginner edition
description: Ready to future-proof your career with Artificial Intelligence (AI)? ChatGPT is a powerful AI generative tool that can help you revolutionize the way you work. In this course, you will learn the importance of generative and possible implications AI, the capabilities of ChatGPT, as well as the importance and ethical implications of AI, so that you can use ChatGPT efficiently and responsibly, and ultimately, can be future-ready.

title: Skills Test - Admin and Customer Support
description: Master the art of customer support and administrative tasks with Skills Test-Admin and Customer Support. This course provides personalised evaluation and feedback from industry experts to improve your ability to provide top-notch customer support, manage administrative tasks, and optimise workflows. Benchmark your skills against market standards and take your career to the next level. Enrol today and enhance your skills.
